name: Ricardo Alves Pereira
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. Growing up in São Paulo, he initially pursued a career in mechanical engineering, but a chance encounter with a local racing team ignited a passion for the precision and speed required in racing. He honed his skills working on various touring car projects, quickly establishing himself as a reliable and detail-oriented machinist.

He joined Akkodis ASP Team five years ago, bringing a wealth of experience in engine component fabrication and repair. Ricardo's pragmatic approach focuses on efficiency and durability, ensuring that every part meets stringent performance standards. He is known for his ability to quickly diagnose and resolve mechanical issues, often devising innovative solutions under pressure. His colleagues appreciate his calm demeanor and unwavering commitment to quality.

Ricardo is a meticulous machinist, always striving for perfection. He's known for his ability to adapt quickly to new technologies and materials, making him a valuable asset to the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Ricardo is a man of medium build with a focused gaze and a practical air.
